title: What follows if the curve keeps going?
description: One brief. The entire production. Research the pace of AI progress, follow its consequences from six months to ten years, and turn it into an original documentary. The agent owns the research, script, motion design, narration, music, edit, and final cut.
look_for: Can you follow the argument without pausing? Do the visuals explain something, or just decorate the narration? Listen to the pacing and sound mix. Check where sourced facts become extrapolation, and where extrapolation becomes speculation.
